title: Mixed Event — Wonder Magical Showtime! — Episode3 Connected Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Phoenix Wonderland is faced with a transformation at the hands of Emu's brothers to appeal to the young adult crowd. In order to make sure it stays a place that makes everyone smile, Wonderlands×Showtime prepares a new show. In time, the curtain rises on a show unlike any other!

rows.Line: Phoenix Stage

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I've been coming to this park since I was a little girl...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This was where I learned for the first time that places as fun and wonderful as this existed.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: All the singing and dancing felt like it came straight out of a movie. It was so beautiful to see, and I wanted to be a part of that...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: The Rainbow Stage was a particular favorite of mine. So much so that I was talking to members of its troupe on a regular basis.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The Rainbow Stage...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: It's an old stage that used to be in this park. I really, really loved it too...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But it was one of the first things to go...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: How this park is run began to gradually change so that it would appeal more to young people, and it's been bothering me for so long...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But I was in no position to say anything since the Phoenix Stage was benefiting from those changes.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Then I realized something. I looked out into the audience one day and noticed that there were almost no children or elderly guests.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: It suddenly felt like that little girl from my memories would no longer be welcome here.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Seiryuin...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: As a business, this park may very well be headed in the right direction. Phoenix Wonderland should be able to stay open if more young people come and visit.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: But this used to be a place for everyone. At the very least, I loved what this park used to be.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Which is why...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I want to see that Phoenix Wonderland again. I want this park to be “a place that makes everyone smile.”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: That means...!!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You'll help us?!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
I will.
However, what the other members of my troupe wish to do is entirely up to them.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: So, what do you think?

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: To be honest, it was sad seeing all of our usual guests not show up little by little...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: Yeah. I thought that was just how things were gonna be from now on, but maybe we still have time to turn that around...

rows.Speaker: Cast
rows.Line: If you're in, Sakurako, then I'll help too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Th-This is super duper wonderhoy!!
Thank you so much, Sakurako♪

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Uh, yes... Of course...
We're on a first name basis now...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Great! Now that we have you, we can start gathering more cast members!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Yes... But let's go talk to the troupes that already once turned you down...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, why...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I'm generally aware of what's going on with the other troupes. The members of my troupe often exchange information amongst themselves.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: By changing your angle, you may actually be able to convince them into joining you.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And once they hear that the Phoenix Stage has joined our side, I'm sure they'll be more willing to hear us out.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Right...!
That's great!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for agreeing to help us, Seiryuin. Let's make this happen...!!

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line:
Of course, Tenma.
Let's make this show one for the ages.
By the merry-go-round

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry to bother you again!
Please, would you mind giving us just one more chance?!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line:
You again...?
Sorry but we're not...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hello. Do you have some time to talk?

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: What? Seiryuin...?

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: If I recall correctly, you were the one that fought the hardest against the removal of the Rainbow Stage...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: I wasn't able to do anything back then either, but now's a different story...

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: This plan promises to bring what is truly best for this park. Please, help us...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We beg you! As cast members of Phoenix Wonderland, please hear us out!

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Fine. Just for a little while, okay...?
se_event_wonders_2021_009
The next day

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Wonder Stage

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I don't believe it...! This is how many people are involved with all the stages and their troupes...?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Thanks, Seiryuin...
None of this would've been possible if you weren't here with us.

rows.Speaker: Sakurako
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Next is your turn, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: As the troupe leader of the Wonder Stage, I believe you know what you have to do now?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Ah, yes, of course...!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh? What's happening?
What are you gonna do, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Just sit back and watch!
You are about to see what your future star, Tsukasa Tenma, is really made of!
